relevance_note: The paper describes four individually characterised patients with heterozygous TNFAIP3 variants: 'WES revealed heterozygous c.559C > T in the TNFAIP3 gene in P1, P2 and P3, while the c.259C > T mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene was identified in P4.'
method_note: Read the full paper by hand; a short Python script (scratch only) assembled the JSON from values I transcribed, and I checked each transcribed table cell against Tables 1-3. Labels: the text labels P1-P4 are used (Table 1/2 'Patient no'/'No' 1-4 and Table 3 'Case 1/2/4' map to P1, P2, P4). Table 3 has patients as columns (header 'Case n' / 'Pretherapy'); lab features were taken only from pretherapy columns, and only for values outside the table's 'Normal range' column; in-range values were not turned into exclusions. Relatives: P4's parents tested negative ('not found in her parents') get rows 'parent of P4' and 'parent of P4 2' (sex not stated). Other tested-negative members of family 1 ('not detected in other members in family 1'; grandparents mentioned only in consent text and Fig. 3 legend) are not described individually and got no rows. Table 2 'No' cells were read as explicit absence (a word, not a symbol); Table 3 '–' cells were not used. Group statement 'All patients had no signs of eye or skin problems' names all four patients and was used for group-inferred exclusions. Contradictions: (1) P2 onset 'at age 2.6' (text) vs '2.5 years' (Table 1); P4 onset 'at the age of 7 years' (text) vs '6.9 years' (Table 1), and '9-year-old' (text) vs current age '8.3 years' (Table 1); Table 1 values were recorded. (2) P4: oral ulcers in text vs Table 2 Ulcers 'No' -> both rows emitted, checklist oral ulcers not reported; genital ulcers left not reported because the only evidence is that contradicted cell. (3) Fig. 2 legend attributes chronic knee synovitis (2e) and ILD (2f) to P3, while the text cites Fig. 2e/2f for P4 and P3 'refused further assessment'; legend statements were recorded for P3 as written, and P3 ILD (vs Table 2 lung 'No') is a contradiction -> checklist ILD not reported. (4) P1: text 'other autoantibodies were negative' vs Table 3 Anti-dsDNA '+'; P4: text 'positive ANA and anti-ds DNA antibodies' vs 'no other autoantibody was detected' -> both rows emitted; the checklist autoantibody item stays observed via ANA, which is not contradicted. (5) P2 Table 2 Ulcers 'No' while endoscopy found GI ulcers; the Ulcers column was read as mucocutaneous (P3's cell is 'Oral') and no generic 'ulcers' exclusion was emitted for P2. P4 Table 2 Liver 'No' alongside raised ALT/AST/LDH in text; liver 'No' kept. Judgement calls: P2 and P4 'fever of unknown origin' was not counted as 'recurrent fever' (checklist not reported); P1 'intermittent fever' was. P1 cytopenias (leukopenia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, positive Coombs) counted for 'cytopenia (autoimmune)' though the paper does not call them autoimmune. P1 hypothyroidism and liver fibrosis were not mapped to autoimmune thyroiditis or autoimmune hepatitis; P1 pericardial effusion and ascites not mapped to serositis; P3 anal fistula not mapped to GI inflammation. P3 de novo: the paper states WES of all Fig. 1 members, non-detection in other family 1 members, and 'de novo for P3', but does not name P3's parents as tested. Variant type left 'not reported' for c.559C > T (no class stated); 'nonsense' only for p.R87X. Transcript printed without version (RS:NM_006290). HLA-B27 positivity (P2, P4) not recorded as a phenotype. The variant c.559C > T 'was reported by other study [16]' concerns the variant, not the same patients, so cites_prior_report is null.
